proposed_widenings.name: GrantResistanceOperation
proposed_widenings.justification: Stoneskin grants Resistance to three damage types (Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing) as an ongoing concentration effect. OngoingOperation currently only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit variants. A grant_resistance variant is needed. The v4 atom grant_resistance already exists (Section 9 Effect Atoms), so no new atom is required — only a new surface variant of OngoingOperation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

notes: Family fit is clean: ongoing_effect, target (one, touch), concentration up to 1 hour. All header fields encode without issue. The consumed material component (diamond dust) is representable as a string in components.m. The sole gap is OngoingOperation lacking a grant_resistance variant. No new atom is needed; the widening is purely at the surface type level.
